title: Affordable Housing (AH) / Rehabilitation & Resettlement (R&R)
scope: Affordable Housing (AH) and Rehabilitation & Resettlement (R&R) construction — for housing those displaced by projects (DP / MUTP / MUIP / vital public projects). Categories: EWS, LIG, MIG, or Rental Housing.

part_A_govt_authority_plots.scope: Development on plots earmarked/reserved for AH/R&R on land of MCGM / Govt. / Appropriate Authority (or unreserved plots in their possession)
part_A_govt_authority_plots.not_permissible_categories: Any tenement type other than the above
part_A_govt_authority_plots.fungible_premium: None (fungible + Reg 31(1) items free of premium for AH/R&R)
part_A_govt_authority_plots.infra_fund_share_ratio: 5/7 of the 7% goes to infrastructure development fund

sale_proceeds_utilization.note: After deduction of dev cost + off-site infra charges

part_A_govt_authority_plots.land_lease: Land with approved BUA leased to society of building occupants
part_A_govt_authority_plots.note_r_r_reserved_land: MCGM/Public Authority may develop AH/R&R on R&R-reserved plots; NOT applicable when private owner undertakes development

part_B_private_or_other_plots.scope: Development on private plot OR plot of authority other than Govt/MCGM/Appropriate Authority, on non-reserved/non-designated land — with AH/R&R handed over free of cost to MCGM
part_B_private_or_other_plots.carpet_excludes: Features permissible free of FSI per Reg 31
part_B_private_or_other_plots.handover_marking_requirement: Owner declares intent up-front; AH/R&R clearly marked on plan as 'to be handed over to MCGM'

release_of_additional_fsi.final_sale_release: 100% sale released only after entire AH/R&R handover to MCGM
release_of_additional_fsi.tdr_alternative: TDR permitted in lieu of unconsumed sale component; 20% of TDR withheld until full AH handover

part_B_private_or_other_plots.occupation_certificate_condition: OC for sale portion granted only AFTER AH/R&R handover to MCGM
part_B_private_or_other_plots.fungible_premium: None (fungible + Reg 31 free for AH/R&R portion; premium applies to owner's share where required)
part_B_private_or_other_plots.zonal_fsi_use_by_owner: Zonal + column (7) BUA usable for zone-permissible uses

part_C_shramsafalya_ashray_yojana.applicability: Constructed under provisions of (A) or (B) with special permission of Municipal Commissioner
part_C_shramsafalya_ashray_yojana.tenement_size: Governed by requirements of Shramsafalya/Ashray schemes

cross_references.reg_32_tdr: TDR in lieu of unconsumed sale component (20% withheld until AH handover)
cross_references.reg_33_10: Amenity list and other relaxations sometimes borrowed

extraction_gaps.calculator_status: PENDING — needs a 33(20)(A) or 33(20)(B) feasibility to validate the sale/AH release proportions + TDR withholding formula before authoring Reg33_20_Calculator.php
